admission.justification: Guards against another task or evidence-copy contract aborting a canonical task-document publication, while preserving a named fail-closed path when own copy ownership cannot be established.

applicability: Task-document copy refresh for contracts with a readable, nonempty task_artifact cell.
conditions: A publication supplies the written JSON/Markdown paths; selection tests their path spellings before full contract loading.
exclusions: Files lacking a readable artifact cell: the separate conditional unrecognized-file rule applies.
Other task folders are not traversed by this refresh.
Copy contents/placement remain the existing publication contract.
statement: After a task-document write, only enclosures whose raw task_artifact cell names a written document are loaded; sibling contracts in the same task folder are never loaded.
